title: MemForest: Efficient Agent Memory Management via EventTree Partitioning and Progressive Merging
abstract: arXiv:2609.08273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent memory systems have demonstrated significant potential in long-term dialogue, personalized assistants, and video understanding. However, continuously accumulated memory introduces substantial storage and retrieval costs during inference. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MemForest}, a general memory compression framework adaptable to various agent memory systems. Specifically, MemForest partitions historical memory into event-centric units by leveraging global semantic similarity and local temporal continuity. For each unit, it constructs a maximum spanning tree, termed an EventTree, and progressively merges redundant memory nodes by selecting high-weight edges, reducing storage overhead. Furthermore, we introduce an anchor-guided propagation retrieval mechanism that retrieves relevant memory nodes from the temporal neighborhoods of key nodes, improving retrieval accuracy. translated_title: MemForest：基于事件树划分与渐进式合并的高效智能体记忆管理
translated_abstract: 智能体记忆系统在长期对话、个性化助手和视频理解等领域已展现出巨大潜力。然而，持续累积的记忆会在推理过程中带来巨大的存储和检索成本。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MemForest，这是一个可适配各种智能体记忆系统的通用记忆压缩框架。具体而言，MemForest通过利用全局语义相似性和局部时间连续性，将历史记忆划分为以事件为中心的单元。对于每个单元，它构建一棵最大生成树（称为EventTree），并通过选择高权重边渐进式地合并冗余记忆节点，从而降低存储开销。此外，我们引入了一种锚点引导的传播检索机制，从关键节点的时间邻域中检索相关记忆节点，以提高检索准确性。大量实验证明了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出了通用记忆压缩框架MemForest，通过事件树划分和渐进式合并降低智能体记忆系统的存储成本，并借助锚点引导的传播检索机制提升检索准确性。
en_tdlr: MemForest is a general memory compression framework that reduces storage costs in agent memory systems through EventTree partitioning and progressive merging, while improving retrieval accuracy via an anchor-guided propagation retrieval mechanism.
